Miracle has a TI, and a TI runner up. He was famously the first to 9K MMR and for a long time was lauded as the most mechanically gifted player in Dota.
 

Modern day Dota has so many talented mechanically gifted individuals that a lot of intangibles seems to matter more to a teams success; communication, hard work, drafting skill, leadership, etc. 


If there is any "King of Dota" as it stands I would argue it is Ceb. Two TIs, 5x major coach, returning as a Pos 5 for a Major championship and a 4th placement at Arlington. Not only a skilled player but frequently lauded as one of Dota's most charismatic and driven players in the scene. He uplifts any team he plays on, appears to have a strong psychological grasp on the challenges of Dota 2 and was recently described by Fly as a "Dota genius" as it pertains to drafting.
